items.answer: I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.
items.audioText: I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I was hungry, so
hints.en: The first half: I was hungry, so

explanation.he: החלק השני הוא תוצאה של הראשון: הייתי רעב/ה ולכן הכנתי כריך. לתוצאה משתמשים ב־so.
explanation.en: The second part is a result of the first, so we use so.

items.answer: We stayed at home because it was raining.
items.audioText: We stayed at home because it was raining.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We stayed at home
hints.en: The first half: We stayed at home

explanation.he: הגשם הוא הסיבה שנשארנו בבית. לסיבה משתמשים ב־because. so היה הופך את הסדר: הגשם היה תוצאה.
explanation.en: The rain is the reason, so we use because.

items.answer: My brother likes football, but I prefer basketball.
items.audioText: My brother likes football, but I prefer basketball.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My brother likes football,
hints.en: The first half: My brother likes football,

explanation.he: יש כאן ניגוד בין שני אנשים. לניגוד משתמשים ב־but.
explanation.en: There is a contrast between two people, so we use but.

items.answer: She plays the piano and the guitar.
items.audioText: She plays the piano and the guitar.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She plays the piano
hints.en: The first half: She plays the piano

explanation.he: מוסיפים עוד פריט לרשימה, ולכן and.
explanation.en: We add another item, so we use and.

items.answer: Hurry up, or you'll miss the bus.
items.audioText: Hurry up, or you'll miss the bus.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Hurry up, or you'll
hints.en: The first half: Hurry up, or you'll

explanation.he: or אחרי בקשה פירושו 'אחרת': אם לא ממהרים, מפספסים את האוטובוס.
explanation.en: After a request, or means 'if not': if you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.

items.answer: Although the test was hard, Noa got a good grade.
items.audioText: Although the test was hard, Noa got a good grade.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Although the test was hard,
hints.en: The first half: Although the test was hard,

explanation.he: יש כאן ניגוד מפתיע, ואחרי המילה בא משפט שלם (the test was hard). לכן Although. despite בא רק עם שם עצם.
explanation.en: The result is surprising and a full clause follows, so Although. Despite needs a noun.

items.answer: Although he trained every day, he didn't win the race.
items.audioText: Although he trained every day, he didn't win the race.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Although he trained every day,
hints.en: The first half: Although he trained every day,

explanation.he: מצפים שאימון יביא לניצחון, אבל זה לא קרה. זה ניגוד, ואחריו משפט שלם, לכן Although.
explanation.en: We expect training to bring a win, but it didn't. Contrast + full clause = Although.

items.answer: I couldn't sleep because my neighbors were having a loud party.
items.audioText: I couldn't sleep because my neighbors were having a loud party.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I couldn't sleep because my neighbors
hints.en: The first half: I couldn't sleep because my neighbors

explanation.he: המסיבה הרועשת היא הסיבה שלא נרדמתי, לכן because.
explanation.en: The loud party is the reason I couldn't sleep, so because.

items.answer: Despite the heavy rain, the match went on.
items.audioText: Despite the heavy rain, the match went on.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Despite the heavy rain,
hints.en: The first half: Despite the heavy rain,

explanation.he: המשחק המשיך למרות הגשם: ניגוד. אחרי הרווח בא שם עצם (the heavy rain), ולכן Despite. Although צריך משפט שלם עם פועל.
explanation.en: The match continued even with the rain: contrast. A noun follows, so Despite. Although needs a clause with a verb.

items.answer: We'll have the picnic in the park unless it rains.
items.audioText: We'll have the picnic in the park unless it rains.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We'll have the picnic in
hints.en: The first half: We'll have the picnic in

explanation.he: unless = if not. נעשה פיקניק אם לא ירד גשם.
explanation.en: unless = if not: we'll have the picnic if it doesn't rain.

items.answer: Unless we act now, many of these animals will disappear.
items.audioText: Unless we act now, many of these animals will disappear.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Unless we act now, many
hints.en: The first half: Unless we act now, many

explanation.he: החיות ייעלמו אם לא נפעל. unless = if not. עם If המשפט אומר שהפעולה תגרום להיעלמות, וזה הפוך.
explanation.en: The animals will disappear if we don't act. unless = if not.

items.answer: Wear a coat. Otherwise, you'll catch a cold.
items.audioText: Wear a coat. Otherwise, you'll catch a cold.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Wear a coat. Otherwise,
hints.en: The first half: Wear a coat. Otherwise,

explanation.he: Otherwise פירושו 'אחרת': בלי מעיל אפשר להצטנן.
explanation.en: Otherwise means 'if not': if you don't wear a coat, you'll catch a cold.

items.answer: Instead of taking the bus, she walked to school.
items.audioText: Instead of taking the bus, she walked to school.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Instead of taking the bus,
hints.en: The first half: Instead of taking the bus,

explanation.he: היא הלכה ברגל במקום לנסוע. Instead of + ing פירושו 'במקום ל...'.
explanation.en: She walked and didn't take the bus. Instead of + -ing = in place of.

items.answer: Noa was tired because she had worked all night.
items.audioText: Noa was tired because she had worked all night.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Noa was tired because she
hints.en: The first half: Noa was tired because she

explanation.he: העבודה כל הלילה היא הסיבה לעייפות. הסיבה באה אחרי because.
explanation.en: Working all night is the reason she was tired, so because.

items.answer: I called him three times, but he didn't answer.
items.audioText: I called him three times, but he didn't answer.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I called him three times,
hints.en: The first half: I called him three times,

explanation.he: התקשרתי שלוש פעמים, והוא בכל זאת לא ענה: ניגוד. לכן but.
explanation.en: I called three times and still no answer: contrast, so but.

items.answer: We bought bread, cheese and tomatoes for the trip.
items.audioText: We bought bread, cheese and tomatoes for the trip.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We bought bread, cheese and
hints.en: The first half: We bought bread, cheese and

explanation.he: ברשימה משתמשים ב־and לפני הפריט האחרון.
explanation.en: In a list, use and before the last item.

items.answer: My phone is quite old. However, it still works perfectly.
items.audioText: My phone is quite old. However, it still works perfectly.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My phone is quite old.
hints.en: The first half: My phone is quite old.

explanation.he: יש ניגוד: ישן אבל עובד. However פותח משפט חדש ובא אחריו פסיק. Although מחבר שני חלקים באותו משפט ולא בא לבד עם פסיק.
explanation.en: There is contrast. However starts a new sentence with a comma. Although joins two clauses in one sentence.

items.answer: Although the film got bad reviews, it was a big success.
items.audioText: Although the film got bad reviews, it was a big success.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Although the film got bad reviews,
hints.en: The first half: Although the film got bad reviews,

explanation.he: שני חלקים באותו משפט עם ניגוד: Although. However לא מחבר שני חלקים בתוך משפט אחד, ו־Despite לא בא לפני משפט עם פועל.
explanation.en: Two clauses in one sentence with contrast: Although. However doesn't join clauses, and Despite isn't followed by a clause.

items.answer: Despite feeling ill, she went to work.
items.audioText: Despite feeling ill, she went to work.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Despite feeling ill, she
hints.en: The first half: Despite feeling ill, she

explanation.he: היא הלכה לעבודה למרות שהרגישה רע: ניגוד. Despite + ing מתאים כאן.
explanation.en: She went to work even though she felt ill. Despite + -ing shows contrast.

items.answer: Cycling to school is cheap. Moreover, it keeps you fit.
items.audioText: Cycling to school is cheap. Moreover, it keeps you fit.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Cycling to school is cheap.
hints.en: The first half: Cycling to school is cheap.

explanation.he: זול ובריא: שני יתרונות. Moreover מוסיף עוד נקודה באותו כיוון.
explanation.en: Cheap and healthy: two advantages. Moreover adds another point.

items.answer: In addition to English, Maya speaks Arabic and French.
items.audioText: In addition to English, Maya speaks Arabic and French.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: In addition to English, Maya
hints.en: The first half: In addition to English, Maya

explanation.he: מאיה יודעת אנגלית ועוד שתי שפות. In addition to פירושו 'בנוסף ל'.
explanation.en: Maya speaks English and two more languages. In addition to means 'as well as'.

items.answer: I forgot my keys, so I had to wait outside.
items.audioText: I forgot my keys, so I had to wait outside.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I forgot my keys, so
hints.en: The first half: I forgot my keys, so

explanation.he: שכחתי מפתחות, ולכן חיכיתי בחוץ. התוצאה באה אחרי so.
explanation.en: I forgot my keys, and the result was waiting outside: so.

items.answer: It took me a week to make a decision.
items.audioText: It took me a week to make a decision.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: It took me a week
hints.en: The first half: It took me a week

explanation.he: אומרים make a decision. בעברית 'מקבלים החלטה', אבל באנגלית receive לא מתאים.
explanation.en: We say make a decision. In Hebrew we 'receive' a decision, but not in English.

items.answer: I have to do my homework before dinner.
items.audioText: I have to do my homework before dinner.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I have to do
hints.en: The first half: I have to do

explanation.he: אומרים do homework. do הולך עם משימות ועבודות. make הולך עם יצירה של משהו חדש.
explanation.en: We say do homework. do goes with tasks; make is for creating something.

items.answer: Can you take a photo of us next to the tree?
items.audioText: Can you take a photo of us next to the tree?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Can you take a photo of
hints.en: The first half: Can you take a photo of

explanation.he: אומרים take a photo. make a photo ו־do a photo לא נשמעים טבעי באנגלית.
explanation.en: We say take a photo, not make or do a photo.

items.answer: Wear a jacket or you'll catch a cold.
items.audioText: Wear a jacket or you'll catch a cold.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Wear a jacket or
hints.en: The first half: Wear a jacket or

explanation.he: אומרים catch a cold. זה צירוף קבוע.
explanation.en: We say catch a cold. It's a fixed phrase.

items.answer: Heavy rain caused flooding in several towns.
items.audioText: Heavy rain caused flooding in several towns.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Heavy rain caused flooding
hints.en: The first half: Heavy rain caused flooding

explanation.he: אומרים heavy rain. strong rain הוא תרגום מילולי מעברית.
explanation.en: We say heavy rain. strong rain is a literal translation from Hebrew.

items.answer: Please pay attention to the instructions.
items.audioText: Please pay attention to the instructions.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Please pay attention

explanation.he: אומרים pay attention. בעברית 'שמים לב', אבל put attention לא נכון באנגלית.
explanation.en: We say pay attention. put attention is a translation from Hebrew.

items.answer: Everyone makes mistakes when they learn a new language.
items.audioText: Everyone makes mistakes when they learn a new language.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Everyone makes mistakes when they
hints.en: The first half: Everyone makes mistakes when they

explanation.he: אומרים make a mistake. do a mistake הוא תרגום מעברית.
explanation.en: We say make a mistake, not do a mistake.

items.answer: We're going to have a party for Dan's birthday.
items.audioText: We're going to have a party for Dan's birthday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We're going to have a
hints.en: The first half: We're going to have a

explanation.he: אומרים have a party (וגם throw a party). make a party הוא תרגום מעברית.
explanation.en: We say have a party (or throw a party). make a party comes from Hebrew.

items.answer: I always take a shower after football practice.
items.audioText: I always take a shower after football practice.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I always take a
hints.en: The first half: I always take a

explanation.he: אומרים take a shower (וגם have a shower). make a shower לא נכון.
explanation.en: We say take a shower (or have a shower), not make a shower.

items.answer: We've been studying for hours. Let's take a break.
items.audioText: We've been studying for hours. Let's take a break.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We've been studying for hours.
hints.en: The first half: We've been studying for hours.

explanation.he: אומרים take a break. make a break הוא תרגום מעברית.
explanation.en: We say take a break, not make a break.

items.answer: He made a lot of money selling old games online.
items.audioText: He made a lot of money selling old games online.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: He made a lot of
hints.en: The first half: He made a lot of

explanation.he: אומרים make money. בעברית 'עושים כסף', אבל באנגלית do money לא נכון. won מתאים לפרס או להגרלה.
explanation.en: We say make money. won is for a prize, not for selling.

items.answer: Please don't make so much noise. The baby is sleeping.
items.audioText: Please don't make so much noise. The baby is sleeping.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Please don't make so much
hints.en: The first half: Please don't make so much

explanation.he: אומרים make noise. do noise לא נכון.
explanation.en: We say make noise, not do noise.

items.answer: It's your turn to do the dishes tonight.
items.audioText: It's your turn to do the dishes tonight.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: It's your turn to
hints.en: The first half: It's your turn to

explanation.he: אומרים do the dishes. מטלות בית הולכות עם do: do the dishes, do the laundry.
explanation.en: We say do the dishes. House jobs go with do.

items.answer: My dad usually does the shopping on Friday.
items.audioText: My dad usually does the shopping on Friday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My dad usually does
hints.en: The first half: My dad usually does

explanation.he: אומרים do the shopping. בעברית 'עושים קניות', ובאנגלית כאן באמת do. goes מתאים רק בלי the: goes shopping.
explanation.en: We say do the shopping. goes works only without the: goes shopping.

items.answer: Your English has improved a lot. You're making great progress.
items.audioText: Your English has improved a lot. You're making great progress.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Your English has improved a
hints.en: The first half: Your English has improved a

explanation.he: אומרים make progress. do progress לא נכון.
explanation.en: We say make progress, not do progress.

items.answer: Don't worry about the result. Just do your best.
items.audioText: Don't worry about the result. Just do your best.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Don't worry about the result.
hints.en: The first half: Don't worry about the result.

explanation.he: אומרים do your best (לעשות כמיטב יכולתך).
explanation.en: We say do your best.

items.answer: Can you keep a secret? Don't tell anyone.
items.audioText: Can you keep a secret? Don't tell anyone.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Can you keep a
hints.en: The first half: Can you keep a

explanation.he: אומרים keep a secret. save פירושו לשמור לעתיד או לחסוך, ולא מתאים לסוד.
explanation.en: We say keep a secret. save is for saving for later, not for secrets.

items.answer: She always keeps her promises.
items.audioText: She always keeps her promises.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She always keeps

explanation.he: אומרים keep a promise. save a promise הוא תרגום מעברית.
explanation.en: We say keep a promise, not save a promise.

items.answer: The tickets were sold at a very high price.
items.audioText: The tickets were sold at a very high price.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The tickets were sold at
hints.en: The first half: The tickets were sold at

explanation.he: אומרים a high price. המוצר expensive, אבל המחיר high.
explanation.en: We say a high price. A thing is expensive; its price is high.

items.answer: It's dark in here. Can you turn on the light?
items.audioText: It's dark in here. Can you turn on the light?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: It's dark in here. Can
hints.en: The first half: It's dark in here. Can

explanation.he: אומרים turn on the light (וגם switch on). open the light הוא תרגום מעברית.
explanation.en: We say turn on the light. open the light comes from Hebrew.

items.answer: Please turn off the TV before you go to bed.
items.audioText: Please turn off the TV before you go to bed.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Please turn off the TV
hints.en: The first half: Please turn off the TV

explanation.he: אומרים turn off the TV. close the TV הוא תרגום מעברית.
explanation.en: We say turn off the TV, not close the TV.

items.answer: My brother is very tall. He's almost two meters.
items.audioText: My brother is very tall. He's almost two meters.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My brother is very tall.
hints.en: The first half: My brother is very tall.

explanation.he: על אנשים אומרים tall. high מתאים לדברים רחוקים מהקרקע, כמו מחיר או טמפרטורה. long לא מתאר אנשים.
explanation.en: For people we say tall. high is for prices, temperatures and things far above the ground.

items.answer: You should say sorry to your sister.
items.audioText: You should say sorry to your sister.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: You should say sorry
hints.en: The first half: You should say sorry

explanation.he: אומרים say sorry. tell בא בדרך כלל עם אדם אחריו: tell her.
explanation.en: We say say sorry. tell usually needs a person after it.

items.answer: I promise to tell the truth.
items.audioText: I promise to tell the truth.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I promise to

explanation.he: אומרים tell the truth ו־tell a lie.
explanation.en: We say tell the truth and tell a lie.

items.answer: Grandpa loves to tell jokes at dinner.
items.audioText: Grandpa loves to tell jokes at dinner.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Grandpa loves to tell
hints.en: The first half: Grandpa loves to tell

explanation.he: אומרים tell a joke, כמו tell a story.
explanation.en: We say tell a joke, like tell a story.

items.answer: Can you tell me the way to the station?
items.audioText: Can you tell me the way to the station?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Can you tell me the
hints.en: The first half: Can you tell me the

explanation.he: tell + אדם: tell me. say לא בא ישר לפני אדם: אומרים say to me.
explanation.en: tell + person: tell me. We don't say say me.

items.answer: Prices rise every year.
items.audioText: Prices rise every year.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: rise = לעלות (לבד, בלי מושא). raise = להרים משהו (צריך מושא). Prices rise.
explanation.en: rise = go up by itself (no object). raise = lift something (needs an object).

items.answer: If you know the answer, raise your hand.
items.audioText: If you know the answer, raise your hand.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If you know the
hints.en: The first half: If you know the

explanation.he: raise = להרים משהו, ויש אחריו מושא (your hand). rise לא בא עם מושא.
explanation.en: raise + object: raise your hand. rise has no object.

items.answer: The sun rises in the east.
items.audioText: The sun rises in the east.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: The sun rises

explanation.he: rise = לעלות לבד. The sun rises. raises צריך מושא.
explanation.en: rise = go up by itself: The sun rises.

items.answer: We had a lot of fun at the water park.
items.audioText: We had a lot of fun at the water park.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We had a lot of
hints.en: The first half: We had a lot of

explanation.he: אומרים have fun. make fun of פירושו ללעוג למישהו, וזה משהו אחר לגמרי.
explanation.en: We say have fun. make fun of means to laugh at someone.

items.answer: You need to take these pills twice a day.
items.audioText: You need to take these pills twice a day.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: You need to take these
hints.en: The first half: You need to take these

explanation.he: אומרים take pills / take medicine. לא אוכלים כדורים באנגלית.
explanation.en: We say take pills or take medicine, not eat pills.

items.answer: The students will take their final English exam next week.
items.audioText: The students will take their final English exam next week.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The students will take their
hints.en: The first half: The students will take their

explanation.he: תלמידים take an exam. give an exam אומר המורה. make an exam לא נכון.
explanation.en: Students take an exam; teachers give one.

items.answer: If you make an effort, you'll see results.
items.audioText: If you make an effort, you'll see results.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If you make an
hints.en: The first half: If you make an

explanation.he: אומרים make an effort. do an effort לא נכון.
explanation.en: We say make an effort.

items.answer: Could you do me a favor and close the window?
items.audioText: Could you do me a favor and close the window?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Could you do me a
hints.en: The first half: Could you do me a

explanation.he: אומרים do someone a favor. make me a favor לא נכון.
explanation.en: We say do someone a favor.

items.answer: I can't sleep after I drink strong coffee.
items.audioText: I can't sleep after I drink strong coffee.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I can't sleep after
hints.en: The first half: I can't sleep after

explanation.he: קפה חזק הוא strong coffee. heavy מתאים לגשם ולתנועה.
explanation.en: We say strong coffee. heavy is for rain and traffic.

items.answer: It's easy to make friends at summer camp.
items.audioText: It's easy to make friends at summer camp.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: It's easy to make
hints.en: The first half: It's easy to make

explanation.he: אומרים make friends. זה צירוף קבוע.
explanation.en: We say make friends.

items.answer: Who will take care of the dog while we're away?
items.audioText: Who will take care of the dog while we're away?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Who will take care of
hints.en: The first half: Who will take care of

explanation.he: אומרים take care of. זה צירוף קבוע.
explanation.en: We say take care of.

items.answer: Starting a new business means taking a risk.
items.audioText: Starting a new business means taking a risk.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Starting a new business
hints.en: The first half: Starting a new business

explanation.he: אומרים take a risk. do a risk לא נכון.
explanation.en: We say take a risk.

items.answer: Hold your ticket tightly so you don't lose it.
items.audioText: Hold your ticket tightly so you don't lose it.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Hold your ticket tightly so
hints.en: The first half: Hold your ticket tightly so

explanation.he: lose (o אחת) = לאבד, פועל. loose (שתי o) = רפוי, שם תואר. אחרי don't בא פועל בצורת בסיס.
explanation.en: lose = verb (לאבד). loose = adjective (רפוי). After don't, use the base verb.

items.answer: These jeans are too loose. I need a belt.
items.audioText: These jeans are too loose. I need a belt.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: These jeans are too loose.
hints.en: The first half: These jeans are too loose.

explanation.he: loose = רפוי, רחב מדי. lose הוא פועל: לאבד.
explanation.en: loose = not tight. lose is a verb.

items.answer: Lack of sleep can affect your memory.
items.audioText: Lack of sleep can affect your memory.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Lack of sleep can
hints.en: The first half: Lack of sleep can

explanation.he: affect = פועל: להשפיע על. effect = שם עצם: השפעה. אחרי can צריך פועל.
explanation.en: affect = verb (to influence). effect = noun (the result).

items.answer: The new rule had a big effect on students.
items.audioText: The new rule had a big effect on students.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The new rule had a
hints.en: The first half: The new rule had a

explanation.he: a big effect = השפעה גדולה. אחרי a + שם תואר בא שם עצם, effect. affect הוא פועל.
explanation.en: After a big we need a noun: effect.

items.answer: The library was very quiet, so I could study well.
items.audioText: The library was very quiet, so I could study well.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The library was very quiet,
hints.en: The first half: The library was very quiet,

explanation.he: quiet (ie) = שקט. quite (te) = די, למדי. quit = להפסיק.
explanation.en: quiet = שקט. quite = די. quit = stop.

items.answer: My sister is taller than me.
items.audioText: My sister is taller than me.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: My sister is

explanation.he: than (a) בא אחרי השוואה: taller than. then (e) = ואז, אחר כך.
explanation.en: than follows a comparison. then = after that.

items.answer: First we had lunch, and then we went to the beach.
items.audioText: First we had lunch, and then we went to the beach.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: First we had lunch, and then
hints.en: The first half: First we had lunch, and then

explanation.he: then = ואז, אחר כך. than רק בהשוואות.
explanation.en: then = after that. than is only for comparisons.

items.answer: The dog is wagging its tail.
items.audioText: The dog is wagging its tail.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: The dog is

explanation.he: its (בלי גרש) = שלו/שלה, לדברים ולבעלי חיים. it's = it is.
explanation.en: its = belonging to it. it's = it is.

items.answer: It's raining, so take an umbrella.
items.audioText: It's raining, so take an umbrella.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: It's raining, so

explanation.he: It's = It is. It is raining. בלי גרש זו מילת שייכות.
explanation.en: It's = It is. Its without the apostrophe shows possession.

items.answer: Can you give me some advice about which phone to buy?
items.audioText: Can you give me some advice about which phone to buy?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Can you give me some advice
hints.en: The first half: Can you give me some advice

explanation.he: advice (c) = עצה, שם עצם שלא סופרים, ולכן אין advices. advise (s) = לייעץ, פועל.
explanation.en: advice = noun (uncountable, no -s). advise = verb.

items.answer: I advise you to save your work often.
items.audioText: I advise you to save your work often.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I advise you to
hints.en: The first half: I advise you to

explanation.he: advise = לייעץ, פועל. advice = עצה, שם עצם. I advise you to...
explanation.en: advise = verb: I advise you to... advice is a noun.

items.answer: My mom taught me how to ride a bike.
items.audioText: My mom taught me how to ride a bike.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My mom taught me how
hints.en: The first half: My mom taught me how

explanation.he: teach (taught) = ללמד מישהו. learn = ללמוד בעצמך. בעברית 'למד' ו'לימד' דומים, אבל באנגלית אלה פעלים שונים.
explanation.en: teach = give knowledge to someone. learn = get knowledge yourself.

items.answer: Can you remind me to call grandma tonight?
items.audioText: Can you remind me to call grandma tonight?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Can you remind me
hints.en: The first half: Can you remind me

explanation.he: remind someone = להזכיר למישהו. remember = לזכור בעצמי. בעברית 'להזכיר' ו'לזכור' דומים.
explanation.en: remind someone = make them remember. remember = keep in your own mind.

items.answer: I can't remember where I put my keys.
items.audioText: I can't remember where I put my keys.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I can't remember where
hints.en: The first half: I can't remember where

explanation.he: remember = לזכור. remind = להזכיר למישהו אחר, ולכן צריך אחריו אדם.
explanation.en: remember = keep in mind. remind needs a person: remind me.

items.answer: Someone stole my bike from outside the school.
items.audioText: Someone stole my bike from outside the school.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Someone stole my bike
hints.en: The first half: Someone stole my bike

explanation.he: steal + חפץ: stole my bike. rob + אדם או מקום: robbed a bank. העבר של steal הוא stole.
explanation.en: steal + thing (stole my bike). rob + person or place.

items.answer: Two men robbed a bank in the city center yesterday.
items.audioText: Two men robbed a bank in the city center yesterday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Two men robbed a bank
hints.en: The first half: Two men robbed a bank

explanation.he: rob + מקום או אדם: rob a bank. steal + החפץ שנלקח: steal money.
explanation.en: rob + place or person. steal + the thing taken.

items.answer: Speak louder, please. I can't hear you.
items.audioText: Speak louder, please. I can't hear you.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Speak louder, please. I
hints.en: The first half: Speak louder, please. I

explanation.he: hear = לשמוע, הקול מגיע לאוזניים. listen (to) = להקשיב בכוונה. כשהקול חלש מדי, לא שומעים: can't hear.
explanation.en: hear = sound reaches you. listen to = pay attention on purpose.

items.answer: Do you want to watch TV with me?
items.audioText: Do you want to watch TV with me?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Do you want to
hints.en: The first half: Do you want to

explanation.he: watch = לצפות במשהו שזז לאורך זמן: watch TV, watch a game. see TV הוא תרגום מעברית.
explanation.en: watch = look at something moving for some time: watch TV.

items.answer: Look at this photo. Isn't it funny?
items.audioText: Look at this photo. Isn't it funny?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Look at this photo.
hints.en: The first half: Look at this photo.

explanation.he: look at = להסתכל על משהו בכוונה. see לא בא עם at. watch מתאים לדבר שזז לאורך זמן.
explanation.en: look at = turn your eyes to something. see doesn't take at.

items.answer: She walks to school every day.
items.audioText: She walks to school every day.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She walks to

explanation.he: she בהווה פשוט: מוסיפים s. She walks.
explanation.en: With she in the Present Simple, add -s: She walks.

items.answer: My brother watches TV after dinner.
items.audioText: My brother watches TV after dinner.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: My brother watches

explanation.he: פועל שמסתיים ב־ch מקבל es: watches.
explanation.en: Verbs ending in -ch take -es: watches.

items.answer: He doesn't like coffee.
items.audioText: He doesn't like coffee.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: he בשלילה בהווה פשוט: doesn't + פועל בסיס.
explanation.en: With he, the negative is doesn't + base verb.

items.answer: Do you play the guitar?
items.audioText: Do you play the guitar?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Do you play

explanation.he: you בשאלה בהווה פשוט: Do you...?
explanation.en: Questions with you use Do: Do you play...?

items.answer: Look outside! It is raining.
items.audioText: Look outside! It is raining.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Look outside! It

explanation.he: Look! מראה שזה קורה עכשיו. לכן is + ing.
explanation.en: Look! shows it is happening now, so: is raining.

items.answer: Yesterday I went to the park.
items.audioText: Yesterday I went to the park.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Yesterday I went

explanation.he: go הוא פועל חריג. העבר שלו: went.
explanation.en: go is irregular. Its past form is went.

items.answer: Last week my mom bought me new shoes.
items.audioText: Last week my mom bought me new shoes.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Last week my mom
hints.en: The first half: Last week my mom

explanation.he: buy → bought.
explanation.en: buy → bought.

items.answer: We saw a great movie last night.
items.audioText: We saw a great movie last night.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We saw a great
hints.en: The first half: We saw a great

explanation.he: see → saw. seen היא הצורה השלישית ובאה אחרי have.
explanation.en: see → saw. seen is the third form, used after have.

items.answer: Did you finish your homework yesterday?
items.audioText: Did you finish your homework yesterday?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Did you finish

explanation.he: שאלה בעבר פשוט: Did + פועל בסיס.
explanation.en: Past Simple questions: Did + base verb.

items.answer: Where did she go on vacation?
items.audioText: Where did she go on vacation?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Where did she

explanation.he: אחרי did בא הפועל בצורת בסיס: did she go.
explanation.en: After did, use the base verb: did she go.

items.answer: I didn't see your message.
items.audioText: I didn't see your message.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I didn't see

explanation.he: didn't + פועל בסיס: didn't see.
explanation.en: didn't + base verb: didn't see.

items.answer: I was watching TV when the phone rang.
items.audioText: I was watching TV when the phone rang.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I was watching TV
hints.en: The first half: I was watching TV

explanation.he: פעולה ארוכה שנקטעה על ידי פעולה קצרה: was + ing.
explanation.en: A long action interrupted by a short one: was + -ing.

items.answer: Don't worry. I will help you with your project.
items.audioText: Don't worry. I will help you with your project.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Don't worry. I will help
hints.en: The first half: Don't worry. I will help

explanation.he: הבטחה או הצעה ספונטנית לעתיד: will.
explanation.en: A promise or offer about the future: will.

items.answer: Have you ever been to London?
items.audioText: Have you ever been to London?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Have you ever

explanation.he: have + צורה שלישית. go/be בהקשר של ביקור: have been to.
explanation.en: have + past participle. For visits we say: have been to.

items.answer: She has lived in Haifa since 2015.
items.audioText: She has lived in Haifa since 2015.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She has lived in
hints.en: The first half: She has lived in

explanation.he: 2015 היא נקודת התחלה, לכן since.
explanation.en: 2015 is a starting point, so since.

items.answer: We have known each other for five years.
items.audioText: We have known each other for five years.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We have known each
hints.en: The first half: We have known each

explanation.he: משהו שהתחיל בעבר ונמשך עד עכשיו: have + צורה שלישית. בעברית אומרים "מכירים", אבל באנגלית have known.
explanation.en: Something that started in the past and continues now: have known.

items.answer: I lost my keys yesterday.
items.audioText: I lost my keys yesterday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I lost my

explanation.he: yesterday הוא זמן עבר מוגדר, לכן Past Simple.
explanation.en: yesterday is a finished time, so Past Simple.

items.answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
items.audioText: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If it rains tomorrow,
hints.en: The first half: If it rains tomorrow,

explanation.he: בחלק של if משתמשים בהווה, גם כשמדברים על העתיד.
explanation.en: After if, use the present, even about the future.

items.answer: If I were rich, I would travel around the world.
items.audioText: If I were rich, I would travel around the world.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If I were rich, I
hints.en: The first half: If I were rich, I

explanation.he: תנאי דמיוני בהווה: If + עבר, would + פועל.
explanation.en: Imaginary present: If + past, would + verb.

items.answer: This book was written by a famous writer.
items.audioText: This book was written by a famous writer.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: This book was written
hints.en: The first half: This book was written

explanation.he: סביל = be + צורה שלישית: was written.
explanation.en: Passive = be + past participle: was written.

items.answer: The girl who lives next door is my best friend.
items.audioText: The girl who lives next door is my best friend.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The girl who lives next
hints.en: The first half: The girl who lives next

explanation.he: who לאנשים. which לדברים.
explanation.en: who for people, which for things.

items.answer: I really enjoy reading books before bed.
items.audioText: I really enjoy reading books before bed.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I really enjoy reading
hints.en: The first half: I really enjoy reading

explanation.he: אחרי enjoy בא פועל עם ing.
explanation.en: enjoy is followed by -ing.

items.answer: She decided to buy a new phone.
items.audioText: She decided to buy a new phone.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She decided to buy
hints.en: The first half: She decided to buy

explanation.he: אחרי decide בא to + פועל.
explanation.en: decide is followed by to + verb.

items.answer: My aunt is an engineer.
items.audioText: My aunt is an engineer.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: My aunt is

explanation.he: מקצוע באנגלית בא עם a או an. engineer מתחילה בצליל תנועה, לכן an.
explanation.en: Jobs take a / an. engineer starts with a vowel sound, so an.

items.answer: He is a teacher.
items.audioText: He is a teacher.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: לפני מקצוע ביחיד צריך a: He is a teacher.
explanation.en: A single job needs a: He is a teacher.

items.answer: My birthday is in May.
items.audioText: My birthday is in May.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: My birthday is

explanation.he: in לחודשים ושנים: in May.
explanation.en: in for months and years: in May.

items.answer: See you on Sunday!
items.audioText: See you on Sunday!

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: on לימים: on Sunday.
explanation.en: on for days: on Sunday.

items.answer: How much water do you drink every day?
items.audioText: How much water do you drink every day?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: How much water do
hints.en: The first half: How much water do

explanation.he: water זה דבר שלא סופרים, לכן much.
explanation.en: water is uncountable, so much.

items.answer: There weren't many people at the concert.
items.audioText: There weren't many people at the concert.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: There weren't many people
hints.en: The first half: There weren't many people

explanation.he: people אפשר לספור, לכן many.
explanation.en: people are countable, so many.

items.answer: This test is easier than the last one.
items.audioText: This test is easier than the last one.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: This test is easier
hints.en: The first half: This test is easier

explanation.he: easy היא מילה קצרה: easier. לא מוסיפים more.
explanation.en: easy is short: easier. No more.

items.answer: Although it was raining, we decided to go outside.
items.audioText: Although it was raining, we decided to go outside.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Although it was raining, we
hints.en: The first half: Although it was raining, we

explanation.he: יש ניגוד: ירד גשם, ובכל זאת יצאנו. Although = למרות ש.
explanation.en: There is a contrast: it rained, yet we went out. Although.

items.answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
items.audioText: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If it rains tomorrow, we
hints.en: The first half: If it rains tomorrow, we

explanation.he: תנאי ראשון: If + הווה פשוט, will + פועל בסיס. זה מצב אמיתי ואפשרי בעתיד.
explanation.en: First conditional: If + Present Simple, will + base verb. It is a real future possibility.

items.answer: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
items.audioText: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If you study hard, you
hints.en: The first half: If you study hard, you

explanation.he: בעברית אומרים 'אם אלמד', בזמן עתיד. באנגלית אחרי if משתמשים בהווה פשוט: If you study.
explanation.en: In Hebrew the if part is in the future. In English, use the Present Simple after if: If you study.

items.answer: If she misses the bus, she will be late.
items.audioText: If she misses the bus, she will be late.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If she misses the bus,
hints.en: The first half: If she misses the bus,

explanation.he: If + הווה פשוט. she בהווה פשוט מקבלת s, ואחרי ss מוסיפים es: misses.
explanation.en: If + Present Simple. With she, add -s. After ss we add -es: misses.

items.answer: We won't go to the beach if the weather is bad.
items.audioText: We won't go to the beach if the weather is bad.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We won't go to the beach
hints.en: The first half: We won't go to the beach

explanation.he: לא משנה איפה if נמצא במשפט: אחריו בא הווה פשוט, the weather is, ולא will be.
explanation.en: Wherever the if part is, it takes the Present Simple: the weather is, not will be.

items.answer: If you heat ice, it melts.
items.audioText: If you heat ice, it melts.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: If you heat

explanation.he: תנאי אפס: לעובדה שתמיד נכונה משתמשים ב־If + הווה פשוט, הווה פשוט. it מקבל s: it melts.
explanation.en: Zero conditional: for facts that are always true, use If + Present Simple, Present Simple. it takes -s: it melts.

items.answer: If I were you, I would talk to the teacher.
items.audioText: If I were you, I would talk to the teacher.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If I were you, I
hints.en: The first half: If I were you, I

explanation.he: If I were you הוא ביטוי קבוע לנתינת עצה. בתנאי שני נהוג were גם עם I, וזו הצורה המומלצת במבחן.
explanation.en: If I were you is a fixed phrase for advice. In the second conditional, were is used even with I. It is the best form for exams.

items.answer: If my grandmother lived closer, we would visit her every week.
items.audioText: If my grandmother lived closer, we would visit her every week.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If my grandmother lived closer, we
hints.en: The first half: If my grandmother lived closer, we

explanation.he: סבתא לא גרה קרוב. זה מצב דמיוני, ולכן תנאי שני: If she lived ..., we would visit.
explanation.en: Grandmother does not live close. It is imaginary, so it is the second conditional: If she lived ..., we would visit.

items.answer: If I could fly, I would go to Japan for breakfast.
items.audioText: If I could fly, I would go to Japan for breakfast.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If I could fly, I would
hints.en: The first half: If I could fly, I would

explanation.he: מצב דמיוני, ולכן would + פועל בסיס: would go. אחרי would לא בא פועל בעבר.
explanation.en: It is imaginary, so would + base verb: would go. Never a past verb after would.

items.answer: If I had a dog, I would walk it every day.
items.audioText: If I had a dog, I would walk it every day.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If I had a dog, I
hints.en: The first half: If I had a dog, I

explanation.he: תנאי שני: If I had a dog, I would walk it. have בעבר הוא had.
explanation.en: Second conditional: If I had a dog, I would walk it. The past of have is had.

items.answer: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.
items.audioText: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If we had left earlier, we
hints.en: The first half: If we had left earlier, we

explanation.he: תנאי שלישי מדבר על עבר שלא קרה: If + had + V3, would have + V3. לא יצאנו מוקדם, ולא תפסנו את הרכבת.
explanation.en: The third conditional is about a past that did not happen: If + had + V3, would have + V3. We did not leave early and did not catch the train.

items.answer: If you had asked me, I would have helped you.
items.audioText: If you had asked me, I would have helped you.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If you had asked me,
hints.en: The first half: If you had asked me,

explanation.he: בתנאי שלישי החלק של if הוא Past Perfect: had asked. לא שמים would אחרי if.
explanation.en: In the third conditional, the if part is Past Perfect: had asked. No would after if.

items.answer: If she had studied, she would have passed the test.
items.audioText: If she had studied, she would have passed the test.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If she had studied, she
hints.en: The first half: If she had studied, she

explanation.he: תנאי שלישי: If + had + V3, would have + V3. pass בצורה שלישית הוא passed.
explanation.en: Third conditional: If + had + V3, would have + V3. The V3 of pass is passed.

items.answer: I wish I were taller.
items.audioText: I wish I were taller.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I wish I

explanation.he: I wish + עבר פשוט מבטא משאלה על ההווה. עם be משתמשים ב־were (גם was נשמע בדיבור).
explanation.en: I wish + Past Simple is a wish about the present. With be we use were (was is heard in speech).

items.answer: I wish I knew how to swim.
items.audioText: I wish I knew how to swim.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I wish I knew
hints.en: The first half: I wish I knew

explanation.he: משאלה על ההווה: I wish + עבר פשוט. know בעבר הוא knew.
explanation.en: A wish about now: I wish + Past Simple. The past of know is knew.

items.answer: If only you had told me the truth yesterday!
items.audioText: If only you had told me the truth yesterday!

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: If only you had told
hints.en: The first half: If only you had told

explanation.he: If only הוא I wish חזק יותר. על העבר: had + V3. If only you had told me.
explanation.en: If only is a stronger I wish. About the past: had + V3. If only you had told me.

items.answer: She failed the test. She wishes she had studied harder.
items.audioText: She failed the test. She wishes she had studied harder.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She failed the test. She
hints.en: The first half: She failed the test. She

explanation.he: חרטה על העבר: wish + had + V3. She wishes she had studied harder.
explanation.en: Regret about the past: wish + had + V3. She wishes she had studied harder.

items.answer: She can speak three languages.
items.audioText: She can speak three languages.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She can speak

explanation.he: אחרי can, must, should בא פועל בסיס: can speak. לא can to speak ולא can speaks.
explanation.en: After can, must, should, use the base verb: can speak. Not can to speak or can speaks.

items.answer: You look tired. You should go to bed early tonight.
items.audioText: You look tired. You should go to bed early tonight.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: You look tired. You should
hints.en: The first half: You look tired. You should

explanation.he: should נותן עצה: You should go to bed early. shouldn't ו־mustn't הם הפוך ממה שצריך כאן.
explanation.en: should gives advice. shouldn't and mustn't mean the opposite of what is needed here.

items.answer: Can I open the window? It's hot in here.
items.audioText: Can I open the window? It's hot in here.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Can I open the window?
hints.en: The first half: Can I open the window?

explanation.he: Can I ...? מבקש רשות. גם May I הוא אפשרות מנומסת.
explanation.en: Can I ...? asks for permission. May I is also a polite option.

items.answer: When I was five, I could ride a bike.
items.audioText: When I was five, I could ride a bike.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: When I was five, I
hints.en: The first half: When I was five, I

explanation.he: יכולת בעבר: could + פועל בסיס. When I was five, I could ride a bike.
explanation.en: Ability in the past: could + base verb.

items.answer: He's only two, but he can count to ten.
items.audioText: He's only two, but he can count to ten.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: He's only two, but he
hints.en: The first half: He's only two, but he

explanation.he: יכולת בהווה: can + פועל בסיס. מודלים לא משתנים: I can, he can.
explanation.en: Ability now: can + base verb. Modals do not change: I can, he can.

items.answer: She has been working all day. She must be exhausted.
items.audioText: She has been working all day. She must be exhausted.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She has been working all
hints.en: The first half: She has been working all

explanation.he: must להסקה = "בטח". She must be exhausted: כמעט בטוח שהיא עייפה מאוד.
explanation.en: must for deduction = almost sure it is true.

items.answer: The ground is wet. It must have rained last night.
items.audioText: The ground is wet. It must have rained last night.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The ground is wet. It
hints.en: The first half: The ground is wet. It

explanation.he: הסקה על העבר: must have + V3. The ground is wet, so it must have rained.
explanation.en: Deduction about the past: must have + V3.

items.answer: She didn't answer my call. She might have been asleep.
items.audioText: She didn't answer my call. She might have been asleep.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She didn't answer my call.
hints.en: The first half: She didn't answer my call.

explanation.he: אפשרות בעבר: might / may / could + have + V3. She might have been asleep.
explanation.en: Past possibility: might / may / could + have + V3.

items.answer: Dan must be rich. He drives a very expensive car.
items.audioText: Dan must be rich. He drives a very expensive car.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Dan must be rich. He
hints.en: The first half: Dan must be rich. He

explanation.he: must להסקה חיובית: Dan must be rich. יש לו מכונית יקרה, אז זו מסקנה הגיונית.
explanation.en: must for a positive deduction. He has an expensive car, so it is a logical conclusion.

items.answer: The girl who sits next to me is from Haifa.
items.audioText: The girl who sits next to me is from Haifa.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The girl who sits next
hints.en: The first half: The girl who sits next

explanation.he: who לאנשים, which לדברים. בעברית 'ש' מתאים לשניהם, ובאנגלית צריך לבחור.
explanation.en: who for people, which for things. Hebrew uses ש for both; English needs a choice.

items.answer: This is the phone which I bought last week.
items.audioText: This is the phone which I bought last week.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: This is the phone which
hints.en: The first half: This is the phone which

explanation.he: לדברים משתמשים ב־which או that. This is the phone which I bought.
explanation.en: For things, use which or that.

items.answer: That's the café where we first met.
items.audioText: That's the café where we first met.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: That's the café where
hints.en: The first half: That's the café where

explanation.he: where = 'שבו' או 'שם'. אחרי where בא משפט שלם (we first met). which צריך מילת יחס: the café in which we met.
explanation.en: where = in which. A full clause follows where. which would need a preposition: the café in which we met.

items.answer: I have a friend whose father is a pilot.
items.audioText: I have a friend whose father is a pilot.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I have a friend whose
hints.en: The first half: I have a friend whose

explanation.he: whose מבטא שייכות: a friend whose father = חבר שאבא שלו. who's זה who is.
explanation.en: whose shows possession. who's means who is.

items.answer: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
items.audioText: The man who lives next door is a doctor.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The man who lives next
hints.en: The first half: The man who lives next

explanation.he: לאנשים: who (או that). The man who lives next door.
explanation.en: For people: who (or that).

items.answer: Tel Aviv is the city where I was born.
items.audioText: Tel Aviv is the city where I was born.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Tel Aviv is the city
hints.en: The first half: Tel Aviv is the city

explanation.he: למקום משתמשים ב־where: the city where I was born.
explanation.en: For a place: the city where I was born.

items.answer: My brother, who lives in Eilat, is a diving teacher.
items.audioText: My brother, who lives in Eilat, is a diving teacher.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My brother, who lives in
hints.en: The first half: My brother, who lives in

explanation.he: כשיש פסיקים (non-defining clause) משתמשים ב־who או which, אף פעם לא ב־that.
explanation.en: With commas (non-defining clause), use who or which, never that.

items.answer: Do you know the boy who I met at the party?
items.audioText: Do you know the boy who I met at the party?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Do you know the boy who
hints.en: The first half: Do you know the boy who

explanation.he: לאנשים: who או that. the boy who I met.
explanation.en: For people: who or that.

items.answer: We visited Masada, which is near the Dead Sea.
items.audioText: We visited Masada, which is near the Dead Sea.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We visited Masada, which is
hints.en: The first half: We visited Masada, which is

explanation.he: אחרי פסיק משתמשים ב־which לדברים ומקומות. where לא יכול להיות נושא של is.
explanation.en: After a comma, use which for things and places. where cannot be the subject of is.

items.answer: The girl whose bag was stolen called the police.
items.audioText: The girl whose bag was stolen called the police.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The girl whose bag was
hints.en: The first half: The girl whose bag was

explanation.he: whose + שם עצם מבטא שייכות: the girl whose bag was stolen.
explanation.en: whose + noun shows possession.

items.answer: I enjoy playing basketball with my friends.
items.audioText: I enjoy playing basketball with my friends.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I enjoy playing basketball
hints.en: The first half: I enjoy playing basketball

explanation.he: אחרי enjoy, finish, mind, avoid בא פועל עם ing: I enjoy playing.
explanation.en: After enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, use -ing: I enjoy playing.

items.answer: We decided to order a pizza.
items.audioText: We decided to order a pizza.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: We decided to

explanation.he: אחרי decide בא to + פועל בסיס: We decided to order a pizza.
explanation.en: After decide, use to + base verb.

items.answer: She is interested in learning photography.
items.audioText: She is interested in learning photography.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She is interested

explanation.he: אחרי מילת יחס (in, at, of, about, before, after) הפועל מקבל ing: interested in learning.
explanation.en: After a preposition, the verb takes -ing: interested in learning.

items.answer: He promised not to be late again.
items.audioText: He promised not to be late again.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: He promised not to
hints.en: The first half: He promised not to

explanation.he: promise + to + פועל. בשלילה: promise not to + פועל. He promised not to be late.
explanation.en: promise + to + verb. Negative: promise not to + verb.

items.answer: I'm looking forward to seeing you next week.
items.audioText: I'm looking forward to seeing you next week.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I'm looking forward to
hints.en: The first half: I'm looking forward to

explanation.he: look forward to + ing. ה־to הזה הוא מילת יחס, ולכן seeing. אותו דבר: used to (= רגיל ל־) + ing.
explanation.en: look forward to + -ing. This to is a preposition, so seeing.

items.answer: Would you mind closing the door?
items.audioText: Would you mind closing the door?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Would you mind

explanation.he: Would you mind + ing: Would you mind closing the door? (= אכפת לך לסגור?)
explanation.en: Would you mind + -ing: a polite request.

items.answer: Eating vegetables is good for your health.
items.audioText: Eating vegetables is good for your health.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Eating vegetables is good
hints.en: The first half: Eating vegetables is good

explanation.he: כשפועל משמש כנושא בתחילת משפט משתמשים ב־ing: Eating vegetables is good.
explanation.en: When a verb is the subject, use -ing: Eating vegetables is good.

items.answer: My parents want me to study harder.
items.audioText: My parents want me to study harder.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My parents want me
hints.en: The first half: My parents want me

explanation.he: want + אדם + to + פועל: My parents want me to study. בעברית 'רוצים שאלמד', באנגלית לא משתמשים ב־that.
explanation.en: want + person + to + verb. Hebrew uses 'that I study'; English uses to.

items.answer: Please remember to turn off the lights when you leave.
items.audioText: Please remember to turn off the lights when you leave.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Please remember to turn off
hints.en: The first half: Please remember to turn off

explanation.he: remember to = לזכור לעשות משהו (בעתיד). remember + ing = לזכור משהו שכבר קרה.
explanation.en: remember to = remember to do something later. remember + -ing = remember something that happened.

items.answer: I'll never forget seeing the Eiffel Tower for the first time.
items.audioText: I'll never forget seeing the Eiffel Tower for the first time.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I'll never forget seeing the Eiffel
hints.en: The first half: I'll never forget seeing the Eiffel

explanation.he: forget + ing מדבר על זיכרון מהעבר: I'll never forget seeing it. forget to = לשכוח לעשות משהו.
explanation.en: forget + -ing is about a past memory. forget to = forget to do something.

items.answer: She avoided answering the question.
items.audioText: She avoided answering the question.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She avoided answering

explanation.he: avoid + ing: She avoided answering.
explanation.en: avoid + -ing: She avoided answering.

items.answer: Instead of taking the bus, we walked home.
items.audioText: Instead of taking the bus, we walked home.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Instead of taking the
hints.en: The first half: Instead of taking the

explanation.he: instead of + ing: Instead of taking the bus.
explanation.en: instead of + -ing.

items.answer: The teacher let us leave early.
items.audioText: The teacher let us leave early.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: The teacher let

explanation.he: let ו־make באים עם פועל בסיס בלי to: The teacher let us leave. She made me laugh.
explanation.en: let and make take the base verb without to.

items.answer: I can't afford to buy a new phone.
items.audioText: I can't afford to buy a new phone.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I can't afford to
hints.en: The first half: I can't afford to

explanation.he: afford + to + פועל: I can't afford to buy = אין לי מספיק כסף לקנות.
explanation.en: afford + to + verb.

items.answer: Noa said that she was hungry.
items.audioText: Noa said that she was hungry.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Noa said that

explanation.he: am → was. בדיבור עקיף מזיזים את הזמן אחורה ומחליפים I ל־she: Noa said that she was hungry.
explanation.en: am → was. In reported speech, move the tense back and change I to she.

items.answer: Dan said he would call me the next day.
items.audioText: Dan said he would call me the next day.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Dan said he would call
hints.en: The first half: Dan said he would call

explanation.he: will → would. גם tomorrow הופך ל־the next day: Dan said he would call me the next day.
explanation.en: will → would, and tomorrow becomes the next day.

items.answer: He told me that he was busy.
items.audioText: He told me that he was busy.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: He told me that
hints.en: The first half: He told me that

explanation.he: tell + אדם: He told me. say בלי אדם: He said that... בעברית 'אמר לי', אבל באנגלית לא אומרים said me.
explanation.en: tell + person: He told me. say without a person: He said that... Not said me.

items.answer: She said that the test was easy.
items.audioText: She said that the test was easy.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She said that the
hints.en: The first half: She said that the

explanation.he: say + that: She said that the test was easy. tell חייב אדם: She told me that...
explanation.en: say + that. tell must have a person: She told me that...

items.answer: They said they were playing football.
items.audioText: They said they were playing football.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: They said they

explanation.he: are → were. They said they were playing football.
explanation.en: are → were.

items.answer: She asked me where I lived.
items.audioText: She asked me where I lived.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She asked me

explanation.he: בשאלה מדווחת הסדר הוא כמו במשפט רגיל: where I lived. לא מוסיפים do או did.
explanation.en: In a reported question, use normal word order: where I lived. No do or did.

items.answer: Mom asked if I had finished my homework.
items.audioText: Mom asked if I had finished my homework.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Mom asked if I
hints.en: The first half: Mom asked if I

explanation.he: שאלת כן/לא מדווחים עם if או whether: Mom asked if I had finished.
explanation.en: Report a yes/no question with if or whether.

items.answer: Ben said he had lost his keys.
items.audioText: Ben said he had lost his keys.

items.answer: The teacher told us not to touch the screen.
items.audioText: The teacher told us not to touch the screen.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The teacher told us not
hints.en: The first half: The teacher told us not

explanation.he: ציווי מדווחים עם told + אדם + to. בשלילה: told us not to touch.
explanation.en: Report a command with told + person + to. Negative: told us not to touch.

items.answer: You're from Jerusalem, aren't you?
items.audioText: You're from Jerusalem, aren't you?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: You're from Jerusalem,

explanation.he: משפט חיובי, tag שלילי, עם אותו פועל עזר: You're ..., aren't you? בעברית אומרים 'נכון?' לכל משפט, ובאנגלית ה־tag משתנה.
explanation.en: Positive sentence, negative tag, same auxiliary. Hebrew uses 'נכון?' for all; English changes the tag.

items.answer: She doesn't eat meat, does she?
items.audioText: She doesn't eat meat, does she?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She doesn't eat

explanation.he: משפט שלילי, tag חיובי: She doesn't ..., does she?
explanation.en: Negative sentence, positive tag.

items.answer: They went to the beach, didn't they?
items.audioText: They went to the beach, didn't they?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: They went to the
hints.en: The first half: They went to the

explanation.he: כשאין פועל עזר משתמשים ב־do / does / did. went → didn't they?
explanation.en: With no auxiliary, use do / does / did. went → didn't they?

items.answer: He can drive, can't he?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: He can drive,

explanation.he: He can drive, can't he? משפט חיובי עם can, tag שלילי עם can.
explanation.en: Positive with can, negative tag with can.

items.answer: Let's order pizza, shall we?
items.audioText: Let's order pizza, shall we?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Let's order pizza,

explanation.he: אחרי Let's ה־tag הוא תמיד shall we? Let's go, shall we?
explanation.en: After Let's, the tag is always shall we?

items.answer: I'm late, aren't I?
items.audioText: I'm late, aren't I?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: ה־tag של I am הוא aren't I? (לא amn't I). I'm late, aren't I?
explanation.en: The tag for I am is aren't I?

items.answer: You haven't seen my phone, have you?

hints.he: החצי הראשון: You haven't seen my
